I just need three short confirmations before I can accept a cash deposit of this size: (1) the funds belong to you and you control them, (2) no one else is providing or directing the money, and (3) a brief description of where the cash came from. This is a legal requirement for any cash deposit of M$10,000 or more, and I can't book it without them. Your account is open and ready.

Gerald Reid (C-22900) opened Premier Savings A-823A8E today (KYC VERIFIED, docs on file). He wants to deposit M$35,000 cash today and asked to keep paperwork to a minimum. I asked him to confirm ownership/control of funds, that no third party is involved, and the cash source. He declined, said he'd take the money elsewhere if asked for paperwork. Deposit NOT booked. Flagging for review given the cash size, reluctance to explain, and the minimal-paperwork request.
